column1: # One known-good paper per publisher. Populate each DOI from a paper that has
# previously downloaded successfully through Tsinghua access, then run:
#   node scripts/run-canary.mjs --mark     # print sed hints to set last_verified
#   doi             DOI to resolve via Alma resolver
#   args            probe args as key=val;key=val  (leave empty if none)
#   expect_field    field in the probe result JSON to assert on
#   expect_contains substring that expect_field must contain ("true"/"false" for booleans, "*" for non-empty)
# Status legend: SEEDED = placeholder, verify on first live run and replace DOI if needed.
